known_outcome: Council answer (leakage): the code does not specifically require an additional room under 1208.3; the 1208.3 intent addresses room area where a unit has more than one habitable room; as an alternate, a single-room unit can be treated as an efficiency dwelling unit under 1208.4 and need not meet 1208.3.
